# `invariant-loop-condition`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a `while` condition whose simple numeric comparison is fixed by a
literal `const` binding.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Such a condition never controls loop termination. A true condition exits only
through control flow in the body, while a false condition leaves dead code.

## When it fires

The rule is an opt-in style check and only evaluates unambiguous literal
constants and simple comparisons.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn spin() void {
    const limit = 10;
    var i: u32 = 0;
    while (limit > 5) {
        i += 1;
    }
}
```
